SQL data types and DECIMAL vs FLOAT

Data types define allowed values and representation. DECIMAL is exact fixed-point; FLOAT and DOUBLE
approximate binary numbers.
INT ගෙණන් සඳහා, VARCHAR text සඳහා, DATE දින සඳහා. මුදල් වJගේ exact decimal values වලට
Store pharmacy medicine prices and expiry dates.
Choose types · Attribute Type · id INT · name VARCHAR(100) · price DECIMAL(10, 2) · expiry DATE
Each attribute is assigned an appropriate SQL type; the price uses exact decimal storage.
Table එJක් columns සහ result rows එකින් එක compare කරෙන්න.
Expected result: Allows up to eight integer digits and two fractional digits in price.

Interview question: Why not FLOAT for money?
Answer: Binary floating-point may introduce rounding errors.
